world.org_type: a sector pension fund buying senior rated notes of private-credit funds for its matching portfolio through its fiduciary manager

driver: The decisive quantity is a tail probability of a sum of losses on two pools, each concentrated on a different shared shock: one on a few owners whose bad years both cluster the failures and cut their severity, a state of each owner's whole book, the other on the classes of unit that load hardest on the common condition, whose failures arrive together and come with ordinary severities because their owners are having ordinary years; one average severity passes the first pool, one pooled loading passes the second, and only both together put each pool past its cushion
driver_concrete: Kestrel Lane's 98 loans with seven houses at 15.0 per cent subordination and Ostvale's 100 in five cyclical sectors at 16.5: a house in a bad year cuts what its defaulted companies recover (lone defaults about 75 per cent against about 38 with three or more others), the five sectors load about 0.14 to 0.36 on the economy's year against at most 0.05 elsewhere, and the senior tail needs both
stump: Every shortcut buys a note: the agencies' copula Kestrel Lane, the house's year with one recovery Ostvale, the sector loadings with one recovery Kestrel Lane, recovery on the house-year's shock with one pooled loading Ostvale, the co-defaults among a note's own loans Ostvale; with both strands carried into the simulation both notes fail and the fund buys neither
deep_chain: (R1) the house-year's share of each standing from the record's same-house pairs; (R2) each sector's loading on the shared year, five far above the rest and moving together; (R3) recovery on the house-year's shock inferred across the house's whole book, on the closed cohorts; (R4, R5) each note's five-year chance with both strands; (R6) the call; (R7) the subordination for 1 and 0.5 per cent; (R8) the chance by year end; (R9) each portfolio's expected credit loss
judgment: two independent modelling judgments, each needing estimation: the joint default-recovery model under the sponsor house's latent year (a regression calibration on posterior shocks at the whole-book grain, on the closed cohorts), and a loading per sector on the shared year (the marginal likelihood over the year and sector-year factors), whose economy-driven defaults recover well; one pooled loading or larger independent sector factors miss the second
one_fact_test: the largest hint ('a sponsor house in a bad year lets its defaulted companies go for less, across its whole book') rescues R3 and R4 (Kestrel Lane's side); the sectors' hint rescues R2 and R5; neither rescues the call or the joint asks: two of nine results each

differentiation.mark135: mark135 (and its v1 lineage, a log-scale retransformation of a regression's mean) estimates a variance or a mean from one record's own values under an estimator correction; here the decisive quantity is a tail probability on a tranche, set by a dependence between borrowers that lives in which buyout fund held each company in each year, estimated as a fund-year variance component from the default record joined to the deal record, with nothing in any one series' values to correct.
differentiation.task7: task7 values one borrower's rescue by the expected write-off it keeps off its dependants, a directional knock-on through payment flows and a linear expectation; here no borrower causes another's default, a common owner's year shock moves all its companies at once, and the call turns on the tail of a portfolio's five-year loss distribution against a senior note's subordination, which an expectation never sees.
differentiation.task4: task4 corrects a regression slope for a covariate's source-specific recording error; here no covariate is mismeasured: the severity of a loss is conditioned on a latent shared shock that also drives the counts
differentiation.task9: the single-step form of this architecture decided the call on one strand (recovery on the sponsor house's year) with Ostvale failing on almost every route; the results chain grades nine results, adds an independent strand (each sector's loading on the economy's year) that alone decides Ostvale's side, puts the two notes at different attachments and makes the call need both strands, each shortcut landing on another wrong call
